companies.title: Companies (career page URLs or board names)
companies.description: One per line. Paste a career page URL from Greenhouse (boards.greenhouse.io/airbnb), Lever (jobs.lever.co/spotify), Ashby (jobs.ashbyhq.com/ramp) or Workday (nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite). You can also write ats:name (greenhouse:stripe) or just the board name (stripe), which is tried on Greenhouse, Lever and Ashby. Up to 500 per run.

keywords.title: Job title keywords
keywords.description: Keep only jobs whose title contains at least one of these words (not case-sensitive). Leave empty for all jobs.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude title keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these words, for example intern or senior.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Keep only jobs whose location or country contains one of these, for example London, Germany or Remote.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs the company marks as remote.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within the last N days
postedWithinDays.description: Keep only jobs posted in the last N days. Leave empty or 0 for all.

includeDescription.title: Include full job description
includeDescription.description: Adds the job description as plain text. Makes results much larger.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Newest jobs first. 0 means no limit.
